_comment: Every value here is BCZ/The ZAO's own config. Forking zpoidh for your own org? Change every value in this file and the tooling (scripts/, docs/) reads from it instead of BCZ's hardcoded values. See docs/PARTNER-GUIDE.md.
_comment_excluded_bounty_ids: A bounty this repo cast that is deliberately NOT aggregated into the leaderboard. Every entry needs a reason, because scripts/check-tracked-bounties.py refuses an untracked cast bounty otherwise - silence is how R5's nine claimants and bounty one's entrants both ended up scoring nothing.

excluded_bounty_ids.1249: R4, ZABAL Gamez open pot. Accidentally CANCELED instead of withdrawn (rounds/r4/CLOSEOUT.md), which closed off the on-chain claim path entirely. Its 15 real builders were credited a flat +1 directly instead, via offchain_credits, so aggregating this bounty would credit nobody and imply the opposite.
